svg.title: last_block after each event of the running route, decisions 1 to 3
svg.text: Step 2: what each wire remembers, event by event
The running route from decision 1 up to decision 3. After each event: which wire names which, and the run cost c.
both wires name each other: a credit is possible
one-sided: this wire names a partner that has moved on
A SWAP clears both of its wires. A gate on (a, b) makes a and b name each other; any older record on a or b is overwritten.
